newest.title: Why the White House Is Picking AI National Champions and What It Means
newest.description: Why the White House Is Picking AI National Champions and What It Means. The government is officially picking AI winners, and we’re breaking down what 'National Champion' status actually does for companies like Nvidia and Microsoft. Plus, we look at the new UN talks on autonomous weapons and Apple's massive health AI study. What we covered: • Trump administration to name Nvidia, Microsoft and OpenAI as AI 'National Champions' • AP reports UN-backed talks may launch rules for lethal autonomous weapons • Apple launches the Apple Health AI Usage Study in the United States Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways. Listener question: When you hear 'National Champion' applied to a tech company, do you feel safer or more concerned about market competition? What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules. Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next. What changed. Who wins. What you do next. Follow The AI Edge on Spotify for a new AI news and analysis episode every weekday.
